sample.question_description: Predict watered crops after toggling listed valves.
sample.question_preview: Toggle each valve shown in the toggle cards once. Which crop labels will be watered afterward? Options: [1] D [2] A [3] none [4] A, B [5] B [6] C
sample.question:
Toggle each valve shown in the toggle cards once. Which crop labels will be watered afterward?
Options:
[1] D
[2] A
[3] none
[4] A, B
[5] B
[6] C
sample.analysis: Current valves are {'V1': True, 'V2': True, 'V3': False, 'V4': True}. After toggling ['V4', 'V1', 'V3'], the valves become {'V1': False, 'V2': True, 'V3': True, 'V4': False}. Water reaches crop labels ['none']. Therefore choose option 3.

state_content.rules: Water starts at pump P and follows connected pipes. A pipe segment controlled by a valve carries water only when that valve is open. Water can split at junctions.
